title.narrative: Primary Health Care programme in Kenya

description.narrative: Improved access to Primary Health Care (PHC) with focus on Reproductive, Maternal, New-born, Child and Adolescent Health (RMNCAH) services at county level, contribute to improved RMNCAH outcomes ,Reliable and timely flow of funds through national systems to health facilities , and better managed health systems and more sustainable health financing through improved financial management and prioritisation of PHC.
